answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Beth-shemesh: the ark's return, the slaughter of its men, and the capture of Amaziah.

clauses.english: received the returning ark of the LORD and offered burnt offerings
clauses.quote: the men of Bethshemesh offered burnt offerings

clauses.english: saw many of its men struck down by the LORD for looking into the ark
clauses.quote: he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD

clauses.english: was where Jehoash of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah
clauses.quote: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah
